newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares ease, seen treading water.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares ease, seen treading water.

text.p: Slovenia's blue-chip SBI share index eased for the third trading day on Tuesday and traders said shares were likely to tread water over the short term amid a lack of incentives and foreign investors.
* The SBI index eased 0.35 percent or 5.60 points to 1,581.54.
* Port operator Luka Koper was the most actively traded stock, falling 1.83 percent to 2,140 tolars on volume of 4,426 shares.
* Issue C of drug maker Lek led decliners, tumbling 5.43 percent to 33,100 tolars on volume of only one share. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
